metadata.title: Orbifold Morse Handles II. Boundary Regions, Gluing Maps, and Surgery Cobordisms
metadata.abstract: We study four-dimensional quotient handles defined by faithful representations of finite groups in $\mathrm{SO}(4)$ and invariant splittings of indices $1$, $2$, and $3$. We identify their attaching and belt regions as oriented $3$-orbifolds described by labeled singular graphs. We determine the orbifold isotopy class of the boundary gluing map. Fix an orientation-reversing orbifold embedding of the attaching region into an oriented $3$-orbifold. Assume that the embedding induces isomorphisms on local groups. The regions, gluing class, and embedding determine the surgery. For a fixed handle and attaching image, an extension condition on the belt region characterizes diffeomorphisms of the cobordisms fixing a specified common exterior pointwise. For index-$2$ handles, this condition is the vanishing of an integer twist in the fixed boundary coordinates. We use these surgeries to construct a compact connected oriented $4$-orbifold cobordism from every closed connected oriented $3$-orbifold $\mathcal O$ to $S^3$. A finite sequence of index-$2$ orbifold handle attachments from $\mathcal O$ to $S^3$ exists if and only if $\mathcal O$ has no tetrahedral, octahedral, or icosahedral vertices. Let $v_{\mathbf T}(\mathcal O)$, $v_{\mathbf O}(\mathcal O)$, and $v_{\mathbf I}(\mathcal O)$ denote the numbers of these vertices. Among finite sequences of handle attachments of indices $1$, $2$, and $3$ from $\mathcal O$ to $S^3$, the minimum total number of index-$1$ and index-$3$ handles is $\left\lceil\frac{v_{\mathbf T}(\mathcal O)}{2}\right\rceil+ \left\lceil\frac{v_{\mathbf O}(\mathcal O)}{2}\right\rceil+ \left\lceil\frac{v_{\mathbf I}(\mathcal O)}{2}\right\rceil$.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 三维 orbifold 手术的黏合判据与最少非中间指标手柄
analysis.workSummary: 对由有限群在 SO(4) 中的忠实表示及指标 1、2、3 的不变分裂给出的四维商手柄，用带标号奇异图描述三维附着区与腰带区，并确定边界黏合映射的 orbifold 同痕类。固定反定向且诱导局部群同构的附着嵌入后，腰带区延拓条件刻画在共同外部逐点固定的余边微分同胚。
analysis.breakthrough: 任一闭连通定向三维 orbifold 可由这些手柄到达 S³。仅用指标 2 当且仅当无四面体、八面体和二十面体型顶点。指标 1 与 3 的最少总数为三类顶点数分别除二上取整后求和。
analysis.limitations: 微分同胚判据固定共同外部及边界坐标。指标 2 情形中相对延拓要求该坐标下整数扭转为零。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 第44页声明第二作者用 ChatGPT（OpenAI）编辑英文、辅助 LaTeX、核对参考资料及组织论述，并协助审查与修订部分数学论证。作者共同负责数学陈述及证明。其他命中为目录项、orbifold 记号及群分类符号。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.22293v1 · PDF 第44页，Declaration of AI use

analysis.priorityReason: 将局部 orbifold 奇点数据化为精确的全局手柄复杂度。
